text:
emma: Follow-up from yesterday's postmortem. Summarizing concrete acceptance criteria and owners for the chat/streaming reliability work. Need clear done conditions so we can close the action items. :clipboard:

devin: Thanks. I'll draft the technical acceptance criteria. High level: no more than 1% partial responses in synthetic steady-state over 24h canary, median TTFB regressions <5%.

emma: Good. Also add customer-facing SLA impact check: confirm that incidents with reconnect noise don't cause visible session interruptions for paid tenants >99.9% of the time during canary.

harpreet: I'll own the end-to-end runbook updates and alert tuning. Plan: add a dedicated streaming timeout alert, classify it into P1 if >3 hosts affected and P2 otherwise. ETA 5 days.

paolo: Infra tasks: reserve a small warm pool for model workers to reduce cold-start partials. Suggest 4 warm workers per region for the canary window. Needs budget signoff.

emma: Assigning owners/timelines: devin -> reconnect/backoff + SDK rate-limiter PR by 2027-05-09, harpreet -> runbook + alerts by 2027-05-06, paolo -> warm pool provisioning by 2027-05-10, sec-bot -> privacy review for sampled payloads by 2027-05-08, ops-bot -> schedule canary 2027-05-13 to 2027-05-15.

devin: Implementation detail: I'll add server-side idempotency tokens for resumable streams and expose a reconnect_hint header in responses. Sample config I'm putting in the PR: 
```yaml
streaming: 
  reconnect: 
    enabled: true
    max_retries: 5
    base_ms: 250
    max_ms: 60000
    jitter: 0.3
    resumable_tokens: true
```

harpreet: For alerts, proposing these checks: 
- streaming.partial_rate > 0.5% for 10m
- ttfb.p50 increase > 10% for 15m
- reconnect.spike > 200/min across cluster
Will tune thresholds after the first canary.

paolo: Warm pool note: we'll do a small canary-only allocation first. Cost estimate ~0.6 instance-hours per minute of canary. Approving on paper, will confirm with finance.

emma: Decision needed: retention for sampled payloads. Options: 7d, 30d. Security, please advise. @sec-bot

sec-bot: privacy-check: prefer 7d by default for sampled payloads; require opt-in for 30d and automatic redaction of PII (regex rules). Formal review complete in 48h if engineering provides redaction rules.

devin: For partial-response detection, algorithm: detect truncated JSON/EOF mid-entity and mark as partial. Will emit event: streaming.partial_detected with labels {model, region, prefix_hash}. Also add final close code 431 = truncated_output.

harpreet: Add to runbook: automated mitigation steps on detection: 1) flag session for warm restart, 2) if >3 sessions flag within 5m, scale warm pool + notify on-call.

emma: On ownership: devin must add CI gating test that fails PR if median TTFB regresses >7% in the PR benchmark. harpreet will add a nightly synthetic to catch regressions after merge.

devin: OK I'll add a lightweight PR-benchmark that runs a 5-minute synthetic against staging and compares to baseline stored in s3. Quick pseudo-cmd: 
```bash
./bench/stream_synth --duration 300 --out metrics.json 
python tools/compare_baseline.py metrics.json s3://bench-baselines/streaming.yaml --threshold 0.07 || exit 1
```

paolo: One more recurring pattern found: when autoscaler tripped with aggressive downscale, we saw partials during the downscale window. Action: add a temporary scale-hold during reconnect floods for canary. I'll add a limiter to the autoscaler config.

emma: Good catch. Add acceptance test: simulate downscale during reconnect flood and ensure partials don't exceed baseline. Assign to paolo.

ops-bot: scheduled: Canary job "stream-playbook-canary" for staging 2027-05-13 02:00 UTC for 72h with stress pattern. Reports posted to #eng-sre.

sec-bot: noted: need PR link for sampled payloads redaction rules for expedited review.

harpreet: I'll write the runbook steps and include sample commands to triage: 
```
# triage truncated stream
curl -sS -H "X-Prefix: <id>" https://staging/api/streams/<session>/debug | jq .status
# check partial metric
curl -sS https://metrics.internal/api/query?m=streaming.partial_rate
```

emma: Closing notes: I'll maintain a small tracker doc with links to PRs, CI gates, canary results, and runbook. Will post when the first PR lands. Next sync Tuesday 09:30 PT. :calendar:

devin: ACK. Starting PR today.

harpreet: ACK. I will also add a post-merge smoke check job.

paolo: ACK, will provision warm pool and update infra playbook.

ops-bot: Reminder: follow-up sync Tue 2027-05-11 16:30 UTC in #incidents.
